name: streamlive
description: StreamLive — chaînes, sources, URLs, programmes, diffusion et LIVE.

scripts.check:channels: node -e "const c=require('./config/channels');const a=c.map(x=>x.id),b=c.map(x=>x.channelNumber),d=c.map(x=>x.name.toLowerCase());if(new Set(a).size!==c.length||new Set(b).size!==c.length||new Set(d).size!==c.length)process.exit(1);console.log('StreamLive catalogue OK:',c.length)"
